description: Header file defining utility functions, macros, and data structures for RdkEasyMeshController, related to Wi-Fi radio and ALE management, including channel support, radio capabilities, and configuration.

methods.name: get_controller_cfg
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the controller configuration structure.

methods.name: parse_update_client_capability
methods.description: Parses a client association frame for capabilities.

methods.name: map_update_ale_source_mac
methods.description: Updates the source MAC address for an ALE node.

methods.name: map_update_ale_receiving_iface
methods.description: Updates the receiving interface of an ALE node.

methods.name: map_recompute_radio_state_and_update_ale_state
methods.description: Recomputes and updates the radio and ALE onboard state.

methods.name: map_reset_agent_node_onboarding_status
methods.description: Resets onboarding status of a single ALE node.

methods.name: map_reset_all_agent_nodes_onboarding_status
methods.description: Resets onboarding status for all ALE nodes.

methods.name: map_convert_mapunits_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts map units to byte resolution.

methods.name: map_scan_status_to_string
methods.description: Converts scan status flag to string.

methods.name: map_scan_type_to_string
methods.description: Converts scan type flag to string.

methods.name: map_find_radio_by_supported_channel
methods.description: Finds the first radio supporting a given channel.

methods.name: map_get_freq_bands
methods.description: Retrieves supported frequency bands of a radio.

methods.name: map_is_5g_low_high
methods.description: Checks if a radio is 5G supporting low and high bands.

methods.name: map_get_profile_from_bss
methods.description: Guesses profile used for BSS configuration.

methods.name: map_radio_has_profile_with_bss_state
methods.description: Checks if radio has a profile with a specific BSS state.

methods.name: map_get_wsc_attr
methods.description: Retrieves attribute from WSC message.

methods.name: map_is_channel_in_cap_op_class
methods.description: Checks if a channel is in an operational class.

methods.name: map_get_channel_pref
methods.description: Gets channel preference within an op_class list.

methods.name: map_update_radio_channels
methods.description: Updates supported channels of a radio based on configuration.

methods.name: map_merge_pref_op_class_list
methods.description: Merges two op_class lists, choosing lowest preferences.

methods.name: map_optimize_pref_op_class_list
methods.description: Optimizes op_class list by removing redundant channel lists.

methods.name: map_is_no_subband_channel_set
methods.description: Checks if no subband channels are present in a set.

methods.name: map_is_all_subband_channel_set
methods.description: Checks if all subband channels are present in a set.

methods.name: map_sort_op_class_list
methods.description: Sorts op_class and channel lists.

methods.name: map_is_cac_request_valid
methods.description: Validates CAC request for a radio.

methods.name: map_find_local_iface
methods.description: Finds local interface of an ALE based on MAC.

methods.name: map_find_bhsta_iface_from_ale
methods.description: Finds backhaul STA interface from ALE.

methods.name: map_find_bhsta_iface_gbl
methods.description: Finds backhaul STA interface globally by MAC.

methods.name: map_free_ht_vht_he_wifi6_caps
methods.description: Deletes capability TLVs from radio.

methods.name: map_update_radio_caps
methods.description: Updates radio capabilities from TLVs.
